headline: NVIDIA revenue doubles as AI demand surges
caption: NVIDIA reported $115.8 billion in revenue for its third quarter of fiscal 2027, up 103% from a year earlier. Data-center revenue reached $107.6 billion, up 110% year over year. The results underscore continuing demand for AI infrastructure.
